subject: aria-landmarks
text: - Landmarks: nav→Navigation, main→Main, aside→Complementary, footer→Footer, article→Article, blockquote→Blockquote, figure→Figure (tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_roles.rs:74-93)

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **ARIA `role` attribute** — `role_from_name` maps ARIA role names (alert, button, checkbox, dialog, link, tab, textbox, landmark roles, etc.) to AccessKit roles (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:330-393)

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **ARIA state attributes** — `aria-selected` → `selected`, `aria-pressed` → `toggled` (a toggle button; `mixed` kept as Mixed), `aria-invalid` → `invalid` (True / Grammar / Spelling; a value outside the list reads True), read by value on any element — a select's option excepted, its `selected` its chosen state (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:171-181) — since 2026-10-10-snapshot-states; `aria-checked` → `toggled` (`true` · `false` · `mixed`) on a `CheckBox` · `Switch` · `RadioButton` · `MenuItemCheckBox` · `MenuItemRadio` role alone, `aria-pressed` read on every other role, a native checkbox or radio reading neither, and `role="switch"` mapping to `Switch` (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) — `accessibility_states`' fourth test its pin (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:169-213; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_states.rs:134-151; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_states.rs:153-171; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_states.rs:173-192; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_states.rs:245-316; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:395-415) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **Link** — `<a>` is a Link only with `href`, else GenericContainer (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:475-492; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_roles.rs:117-126)

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **Lists and tables** — ul/ol→List, li→ListItem, table→Table, thead→RowGroup, tr→Row, th→ColumnHeader, th scope=row→RowHeader, td→Cell (tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_roles.rs:95-115); `<th>` is RowHeader for `scope=row|rowgroup`, else ColumnHeader (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:475-492)

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **Form input** — `<input>` roles are mapped by `type`, defaulting to TextInput (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:509-527); label→Label, textarea→MultilineTextInput, progress→ProgressIndicator, meter→Meter, radio→RadioButton, range→Slider, email→EmailInput, password→PasswordInput (tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_roles.rs:128-155); text→TextInput, number→NumberInput, checkbox→CheckBox (tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_roles.rs:157-180)

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **Hidden content** — `aria-hidden="true"` keeps the node but marks it hidden (`is_hidden`); `hidden`, `display: none` and `visibility: hidden` exclude it — an `option` whose parent is a `select` excepted from `display: none`, which every option but a single-choice select's chosen one computes: it stays in the tree, `hidden`, `inert` and `visibility: hidden` still excluding it (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:257-258; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:260-273); children of a hidden element are excluded (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:165-168; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_hidden.rs:28-137)
